parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT
  c.id,
  c.name,
  c.domain,
  c.website,
  c.employee_count,
  c.annual_revenue,
  c.tech_stack,
  c.homepage_hash,
  c.last_signal_check,
  c.updated_at,
  -- best lead for this company (highest tier/score)
  (
    SELECT l2.id FROM leads l2
    WHERE l2.company_id = c.id
      AND l2.status NOT IN ('unsubscribed','human_owned')
    ORDER BY l2.score DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS best_lead_id,
  (
    SELECT l2.icp_tier FROM leads l2
    WHERE l2.company_id = c.id
      AND l2.status NOT IN ('unsubscribed','human_owned')
    ORDER BY l2.score DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS best_lead_tier
FROM companies c
JOIN leads l ON l.company_id = c.id
WHERE l.updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
  AND l.do_not_contact = FALSE
  AND c.domain IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY c.last_signal_check ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 50;   -- conservative batch size to protect API rate limits

UPDATE companies
SET
  last_signal_check = NOW(),
  employee_count    = COALESCE($2::integer, employee_count),
  homepage_hash     = COALESCE($3, homepage_hash),
  tech_stack        = COALESCE($4::jsonb, tech_stack),
  updated_at        = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::uuid;

INSERT INTO worker_events (worker_id, event_type, payload, created_at)
VALUES (
  (SELECT id FROM workers WHERE worker_type = 'agent-x' LIMIT 1),
  'company.signal.detected',
  $1::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id;
